billing_note: All six configurations run on free API tiers, so the amount actually billed is $0. Estimated cost uses each provider's published paid-tier list price on the run date. Google's free tier allows Google to use submitted data to improve its products; the notes are public, de-identified MTSamples and PLABA records.
generation_settings_note: No temperature, token cap, or reasoning setting is passed to any model; each provider's defaults apply. Prompts and the revision limit are identical across models.

full_system.lookup_note: UMLS reference definitions are on for every full-system configuration. DrugBank is not part of the pipeline. Baselines use no lookups.

evaluator.note: The automated faithfulness judge is Gemini (gemini-3.8-flash) with the existing factual-evaluator prompt, for all six configurations. Gemini is also a contestant, so the judge may favour Gemini outputs; the blind human review exists to measure that.

pricing.verification: Read from the page's Gemini 3.8 Flash table (output price 'including thinking tokens'). The page shows no last-updated date.

openness.weights: Not available; the model is offered only as a hosted API.
openness.license: Proprietary; used under the Gemini API terms of service.

pricing.verification: The page's Gemma 4 table reads 'Free of charge' (free tier) and 'Not available' (paid tier) for input and output. The table names the Gemma 4 family, not this exact model ID.

openness.weights: Downloadable from Hugging Face (google/gemma-4-31B-it) and Kaggle.
openness.license: Apache 2.0 (Hugging Face metadata 'apache-2.0'; the model card links Google's Gemma 4 license page).
openness.hosting: Google-hosted Gemini API for this leaderboard; the weights can also be self-hosted.

adaptations: Called through ADK's LiteLlm wrapper (OpenAI-compatible chat API); ADK sends each agent's instruction as a system message instead of a Gemini system instruction.
Reasoning effort is left at Groq's default; reasoning tokens are billed inside output tokens.

pricing.verification: Read from the 'Price per 1M tokens' column on the Groq models page; groq.com/pricing showed no price table when checked.

openness.hosting: Third-party hosted API (Groq), reached through LiteLLM.
